defect: the synchronous data input has no input-delay constraint
rationale: data_i and valid_i are sampled by the clk input at the interface register. A clock definition alone gives no external arrival window for data_i, so setup and hold timing at the synchronous boundary are incomplete.

mutation.description: Omitted the set_input_delay constraint for data_i relative to clk.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Retained the clocked AXI input-to-output datapath and reset behavior; reduced the rate limiter to a registered payload and valid pair.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Synchronous inputs data_i and valid_i captured by clk have no set_input_delay.
